notes: Banishers has no per-game AOB overrides in the catalog -- raptoravis's UUU 5.8.11 detects the binary's title id but registers zero specific keys, so it relies entirely on the shared multi-variant UE5 pool. Camera intercept comes from AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1.
